title: Chapter 270 - 270 President Ma'S Call; Shopping!
content:
Chapter 270 - 270 President Ma'S Call; Shopping!

Chapter 270 - 270 President Ma's Call; Shopping!

270 President Ma’s Call; Shopping!

Naturally, Lin Fan did not know that the Hail Conjecture that he had solved had passed the verification process and was about to be published in Annual Mathematics.

Of course, even if he knew, he would not be surprised.

This was the answer given by the system. How could it be wrong?

As for… Annual Mathematics?

Lin Fan did not care at all.

A day of leisure passed in the blink of an eye.

…

The next day, Lin Fan did not order any food.

Instead, he drove the Mercedes-Benz to a restaurant a few kilometers away.

After all, sometimes lying down was also very tiring.

Lin Fan had just eaten his fill when the phone in his pocket rang.

He looked at the caller ID and saw that it was the chairman of Little Tanuki Group, President Ma.

Hence, Lin Fan did not hesitate and answered the call.

“Good morning, Mr. Lin!” President Ma laughed heartily.

“Good morning, President Ma.

“Why did you call me today, President Ma?” he asked after a pause.

President Ma laughed. “Can’t I call you for no reason?”

Then, he added, “However, I did call you this time because I have something to say…

“Mr. Lin, you should know that our country is now vigorously developing the central region.”

“Jiangbei is the central part of Hua Nation and the center of development in the future. Of course, we have to keep up with the pace of the country…

“So, other than establishing a branch in Jiangbei two years ago, we’re also preparing to invest and acquire a group of companies…

“Recently, the person in charge of our branch in Jiangbei told me that he has inspected a group of companies with more potential for development. He asked me to go over and decide if we need to invest or acquire them.

“I rushed to Jiangbei early this morning for this matter…

It had to be said that Da Ma was indeed the capable person who founded Little Tanuki Group.

When he spoke, he was full of tricks.

From the general direction of the country’s development, the topic of conversation gradually became about giving opinions and eating.

In reality?

Yesterday, President Ma suddenly found out that Lin Fan had bought another 5% of Little Tanuki’s shares.

Hence, Lin Fan’s total of 10% of Little Tanuki’s shares made him a major shareholder that far surpassed the CEO’s ranking!

Da Ma was not worried… He just did not know why Lin Fan would increase his shares, so he rushed to Jiangbei early in the morning.

His purpose… He just wanted to meet Lin Fan and have a chat with him.

Regarding this…

Lin Fan understood everything clearly. However, having a meal was not a problem. “Sure.”

Da Ma laughed heartily and said, “Haha! Alright, then it’s a deal!”

The two of them chatted for a while more before hanging up.

When Lin Fan walked out of the restaurant, a graceful figure appeared in front of him.

“Han Tian!” Lin Fan shouted.

Han Tian slowly turned around, and her pretty face immediately revealed a hint of surprise. She called out, “Lin Fan!”

Today, Han Tian was wearing a dress with floral patterns. Her long black hair hung down naturally like a waterfall, and it swayed in the wind. Her entire body was filled with a faint fragrance… It was extremely charming.

Lin Fan asked, “What are your plans today?”

“I’m not going to work today. I’m going shopping,” Han Tian said.

Shopping?

Lin Fan could not help but recall that he had only casually given her two Gucci bags…

After that, he did not give her anything else.

In addition, the time he spent with her was also the least.

Thus, Lin Fan said, “Then I’ll go shopping with you.”

“Really?”

Han Tian’s beautiful eyes instantly became crescent-shaped, and there was a faint starlight shining in them. She was extremely beautiful.

Lin Fan smiled. “Of course it’s true. Let’s go shopping!”

Then, Lin Fan drove his Mercedes Benz to the shopping mall with Han Tian.

They first walked into Chanel.

“Welcome to Chanel.” The dignified female shop assistant quickly came up to them and said, “May I know how I can help you?”

“I’m here to help my girlfriend buy some clothes. Do you have any recommendations?”

The shop assistant secretly sized up Han Tian.

Then, she praised, “Your girlfriend is so beautiful! I rarely see a woman with such fair skin and such a good figure like her!”

It had to be said that the shop assistant’s ability was not bad.

With just a few simple words, the relationship between the few of them had unknowingly become closer.

“Thank you for your compliment.” Han Tian blushed.

“How is this a compliment? This is the truth,” the shop assistant said.

Then, she pointed at a few clothes not far away and said, “I personally think that these two white dresses, as well as those pink and light-colored clothes, are more suitable for you…”

As she spoke, she took out the two white dresses and said, “Moreover, these clothes are all 100% pure cotton. They’ll be very comfortable to wear.”

When Han Tian changed into the clothes recommended by the shop assistant, her already perfect figure became even more prominent.

“Do you like it?” asked Lin Fan. “Is it comfortable to wear?”

Han Tian nodded.

Then, Lin Fan took the two pieces of clothes that he had picked out and said, “Try these two.”

“Alright,” Han Tian replied.

After a while, Han Tian walked out wearing the clothes that Lin Fan had picked out.

Han Tian’s figure was simply too good. Every piece of clothing she wore made people’s eyes light up.

Lin Fan seemed to have realized this and asked, “Do you want to try on other clothes?”

“No need,” Han Tian said.

Lin Fan said, “Alright then. Wrap up these clothes.”

When the shop assistant standing at the side heard this, she was excited and quickly asked, “Do you wish to purchase all the clothes here?”

One had to know…

This was a Chanel store. Three pieces of clothing would easily cost tens of thousands of dollars.

To her, it was a considerable achievement.

Lin Fan shook his head, “No… Including the clothes you pointed out just now, there should be a total of eight pieces.”

The shop assistant was obviously stunned. She could not help but ask, “You… Are you sure?”

“Is there a problem?” Lin Fan asked.

“No problem at all.”

The shop assistant was very agile. She quickly folded all eight pieces of clothing and said, “It’s a total of 137,899 yuan.”

Beep!

Lin Fan took out his bank card and placed it on the machine. The bill appeared.

At the same time, 13 red packets appeared on Lin Fan’s phone.

Seeing this…

The shop assistant’s heart raced. She then bent down and said, “Thank you, and please come again.”

After Lin Fan and Han Tian had left, the shop assistant mumbled, “What a godly tycoon.”

Immediately after, she revealed a regretful expression and said, “If I had known… I would’ve pointed at a few more clothes just now.”
